studio.howTitle: A simple way to get started

pdf.inputHint: Start with a PDF or an image from your device.
pdf.readyHint: Add a file to view its pages, make changes and download a new copy.
pdf.stepUpload: Choose or drop PDF and image files from your device.
pdf.stepEdit: Select pages to organize them, or open a preview to edit text and add annotations.
pdf.stepDownload: Review the Export options, then download your result.
pdf.tip: Choose the magnifying-glass icon on a page to preview and edit it. You can undo changes during your working session.

qr.inputTitle: How would you like to read a code?
qr.resultHint: The code content will appear here
qr.stepUpload: Choose an image, paste a screenshot or open the camera.
qr.stepRead: Keep the code sharp and well lit so its content can be read.
qr.stepCheck: Check the result, then copy it or open the link.
qr.tip: Is the code small or blurry? Crop around it and keep all four corners visible for a clearer scan.

tarot.stageHint: Take a quiet moment for what is on your mind.
tarot.previewHint: Choose the number of cards, then shuffle and draw to begin.
tarot.stepChoose: Choose the number of cards and whether to allow reversed cards.
tarot.stepReveal: Shuffle, draw and tap each card to reveal it.
tarot.stepRead: Read the interpretations and overview, then download your result if you wish.
tarot.tip: Start with three cards for the situation, obstacle and advice. You can choose another spread in a new session.

collage.previewHint: Images are cropped to square cells in selection order.
collage.formats: JPG, PNG, WebP · Choose 2 to 9 images
collage.stepChoose: Choose or drop 2 to 9 images into the upload area.
collage.stepLayout: Set the columns and spacing, then check the preview.
collage.stepSave: Merge and download the PNG image to your device.
collage.tip: Need a logo or more layouts? Open the advanced layouts, logo & ZIP workspace.

imagesPdf.workflow: Steps to create a PDF from images
imagesPdf.stepChoose: Choose images from your device or capture more with your camera.
imagesPdf.stepArrange: Move images up or down to reorder pages. Choose the page size and margins.
imagesPdf.stepSave: Create the PDF, check the result, then download it.
imagesPdf.tip: Each image becomes one page. Use good lighting, hold the camera straight and arrange the images before creating the PDF.

cv.previewHint: Choose a template and see your content update as you type.
cv.inputHint: Start with your personal details, then add your experience and skills.
cv.stepFill: Enter your details, experience, education and skills.
cv.stepTemplate: Choose a template in the preview. On mobile, switch to the Preview tab.
cv.stepSave: Check your content, download PDF / DOCX or print your CV.
cv.tip: Keep it concise and highlight achievements relevant to the role. Enable saved drafts only on a personal device.

compass.stepMeasure: Stand at the main entrance and follow the compass instructions. Without a sensor, enter the degrees manually.
compass.stepLock: Lock the direction once the reading is stable. You can also place the compass on a house photo or plan.
compass.stepSave: Read the facing and sitting directions, then save an image or PDF.
compass.tip: Compare several readings away from metal. The age-based interpretation is optional and for reference only.

playing.stageTitle: A quiet moment with the cards
playing.stageHint: Choose your spread, shuffle and reveal each message.
playing.previewHint: Cards stay face down until you choose to reveal them.
playing.stepChoose: Choose the number of cards for your spread.
playing.stepReveal: Shuffle and draw, then reveal individual cards or the whole spread.
playing.stepRead: Read the interpretation, save the result or start a new draw.
playing.tip: Start with 3 cards to get familiar with the tool. Each draw is a prompt for personal reflection.

numerology.inputHint: Enter your Gregorian birth date. Add your name to include name-based metrics.
numerology.introHint: A perspective on yourself through your birth date and name.
numerology.stepFill: Enter your birth date, optional name and the year to explore.
numerology.stepCalculate: Read the data notice, give consent and calculate your numbers.
numerology.stepRead: Review the calculations and interpretations, then save a report if needed.
numerology.tip: Use your Gregorian birth date. Accents in your name are normalized automatically.

background.settingsHint: Choose a background or use the brush after processing.
background.formats: JPG, PNG, WebP · Up to 20 MB
background.demoLabel: Illustration: keep the subject and remove the background
background.stepChoose: Choose or drop an image. The tool separates the subject on your device.
background.stepRefine: Check the result, choose a background and use the keep / erase brush if needed.
background.stepSave: Download a PNG or continue in the ID photo tool.
background.tip: A clear subject distinct from the background usually works best. Use the brush to refine small areas.

crop.emptyHint: Choose an image to open the editing settings.
crop.crop: Crop with a frame and aspect ratio
crop.stepChoose: Choose or drop an image from your device.
crop.stepEdit: Drag the crop frame, select an aspect ratio, rotate or adjust the lighting.
crop.stepSave: Save the image, check the result and download the edited file.
crop.tip: On mobile, switch between Input and Preview to adjust and check the image. Reset to try again from the original.

read.inputHint: Paste text or open a file, then press Read to listen.
read.placeholder: Type or paste the content you want to hear here…
read.stepInput: Paste text or choose a file to read.
read.stepVoice: Choose a device voice or Vietnamese AI voice, then adjust the speed.
read.stepListen: Press Read; pause, resume or move between sentences as needed.
read.tip: The Vietnamese AI voice supports WAV downloads. Voice data downloads on first use; content is processed on your device.

office.stepOpen: Open the editor to start with a blank document or a DOCX file.
office.stepEdit: Write and format in the editor. Expand the workspace when needed.
office.stepSave: Save or download the DOCX before closing the editor.
office.tip: The editor has an English interface and works best on desktop. Use Ctrl+O to open a file and Ctrl+S to save.
office.note: Files open and edit on your device. Save a new copy before leaving the page.

merge.summaryHint: Combine your selected files into one PDF.
merge.orderHint: Files merge in the order shown in the list.
merge.stepChoose: Choose or drop at least 2 PDF files.
merge.stepArrange: Move files up or down to set the merge order.
merge.stepSave: Merge the PDFs, check the result and download it.
merge.tip: Add or remove files before merging. Password-protected files prompt for an opening password.

convert.introHint: Choose PDFs, select an output format and convert on your device.
convert.stepChoose: Choose one or more PDF files to convert.
convert.stepFormat: Choose Word, Excel or images. Enable text recognition for scanned PDFs.
convert.stepSave: Convert, download the result and review the content.
convert.tip: Word layouts may differ from the original PDF. Review text and tables after converting scans.

qrCreate.inputHint: Choose a content type and enter the details. The QR code updates as you type.
qrCreate.previewHint: Check the content and download a suitable format.
qrCreate.stepChoose: Choose a link, text, Wi-Fi or another content type to share.
qrCreate.stepCustomize: Enter your content and open Customize to change colors if needed.
qrCreate.stepSave: Test the code, then download PNG, SVG or PDF.
qrCreate.tip: Keep strong contrast between the code and background. Test on a phone before printing or sharing.

assistant.introHint: Describe your task and ask which tool to use and how to proceed.
assistant.ideasTitle: A few ways your assistant can help
assistant.writeHint: Describe your task to find a suitable tool.
assistant.summarizeHint: Ask how to enter data and understand tool results.
assistant.planHint: Get source suggestions to verify information and regulations.
assistant.stepSignIn: Sign in to an account with Pro assistant access.
assistant.stepSetup: Complete AI setup in your account if requested.
assistant.stepAsk: Describe your request, send your question and review the answer.
assistant.tip: State your goal, context and preferred output. Ask the assistant to revise its answer as needed.
assistant.note: AI answers can be wrong. Check important information and review the data you send.

lunar.calendarHint: Select a date for lunar details, cyclical names and holidays.
lunar.stepBrowse: Change months or jump to a date with the date field.
lunar.stepDay: Select a day to read the details beside or below the calendar.
lunar.stepConvert: Use the conversion and anniversary sections to find matching solar dates.
lunar.tip: Toggle individual holiday groups. Auspicious hours and days are cultural references.

estimate.inputHint: Enter the house size and your unit prices to estimate costs. Results update as values change.
estimate.resultHint: An estimate based on equivalent area and your inputs.
estimate.breakdownHint: Review each component and its area factor.
estimate.stepArea: Enter the floor area and number of upper floors. Open advanced settings for yards, terraces or rooftop rooms.
estimate.stepPrice: Enter prices from your quotation and choose the correct turnkey-price option.
estimate.stepCheck: Review total costs, equivalent areas and the factors used for each component.
estimate.tip: Prices depend on location, materials and scope. Use a quotation suitable for your project.

idPhoto.emptyHint: Choose a portrait, adjust the crop, pick a photo size and arrange a print sheet.
idPhoto.stepChoose: Choose a portrait or take a photo with your camera.
idPhoto.stepAdjust: Frame the face, choose a photo size and set up the print sheet.
idPhoto.stepSave: Export a single photo, image sheet or PDF and download it.
idPhoto.tip: Use a clear, front-facing photo. Print at 100% scale to keep the correct dimensions.

compressVideo.resultHint: Check the file size, preview and download the compressed video.
compressVideo.stepChoose: Choose a video from your device.
compressVideo.stepSet: Choose a compression level and resolution.
compressVideo.stepSave: Start compression, wait for processing, then preview and download.
compressVideo.tip: Stronger compression reduces quality. Output size also depends on the source; keep the original for comparison.

design.inputHint: Add a title, images or a logo. The preview updates as you enter content.
design.previewHint: Choose a template, check the layout and export.
design.stepContent: Enter your content and add images or a logo if needed.
design.stepTemplate: Choose a template in the preview, then adjust colors and dimensions.
design.stepSave: Choose an output format, export and download your design.
design.tip: Use clear images and logos. Check the dimensions and make a test print before printing in bulk.

family.stepMember: Add family members and choose whose calendar to view.
family.stepEvent: Select a date, add an event and set its visibility and reminder.
family.stepBackup: Use the backup section to keep a copy on your device.
family.tip: The calendar is stored only in this browser on this device. Back up regularly; reminders need the page open and suitable notification permission.

group.peopleHint: Enter one person per line, then add the group’s expenses.
group.resultHint: Suggested transfers to balance shared expenses.
group.stepPeople: Enter each member’s name on a separate line.
group.stepExpense: Add expenses, their payers and the people sharing each one.
group.stepSettle: Review the suggested transfers and each person’s balance.
group.tip: When adding a new person, select the expenses they shared. Renaming a person keeps their existing shares.

address.inputHint: Paste old addresses, one per line. Choose a mapping table to see conversion suggestions.
address.resultHint: Track fully converted rows and review details in the results table.
address.stepInput: Enter each old address on a separate line.
address.stepSource: Apply a signed mapping table if available, or enter your own.
address.stepSave: Review every suggestion and download the CSV table.
address.tip: Review addresses with multiple possible matches. Check the data source and confirm with the receiving office before use.

trimVideo.resultHint: Preview the trimmed clip and download the MP4.
trimVideo.rangeHint: Set start and end times in seconds within the original video.
trimVideo.stepChoose: Choose and preview a video to find the section to keep.
trimVideo.stepSet: Enter start and end times within the video duration.
trimVideo.stepSave: Trim the video, review the new clip and download it.
trimVideo.tip: Clips are re-encoded to MP4 with a maximum long edge of 1080 px. Keep the original to choose another section later.

measure.emptyHint: Choose an image to measure distances and areas or count objects. Set a reference to use real-world units.
measure.stepChoose: Choose a clear image to measure or count.
measure.stepScale: Place both ends of a reference and enter its real length and unit if needed.
measure.stepMeasure: Choose a measurement mode, place points and download the annotated image.
measure.tip: Measurements use pixels until you set a reference. Accuracy depends on the reference, camera angle and point placement; use points on the same plane.

sheet.heading: Open a spreadsheet and start with your data
sheet.stepOpen: Open the spreadsheet editor to create a workbook or open an XLSX file.
sheet.stepEdit: Enter data, use formulas and format cells in your workbook.
sheet.stepSave: Save or download the XLSX before closing the editor.
sheet.tip: The spreadsheet editor has an English interface and works best on desktop. Use Ctrl+O to open a file and Ctrl+S to save.
sheet.note: Spreadsheets open and edit on your device. Save a new copy before leaving the page.

password.fileHint: Choose one PDF. Add or remove a password on your device.
password.resultHint: A new file downloads after successful processing.
password.resultEmpty: Choose a PDF and enter a password in the settings to begin.
password.passwordHint: The opening password needs at least 8 characters.
password.stepChoose: Choose a PDF and the add-password or remove-password mode.
password.stepPassword: Enter the password; confirm it and set permissions when protecting a file.
password.stepSave: Process the PDF to download a new copy, then test opening it.
password.tip: If restricting printing, copying or editing, set a separate owner password of at least 8 characters, different from the opening password.

study.gradeHint: Enter a score out of 10 to see a reference letter grade and score out of 4.
study.admissionHint: Enter three subject scores and priority bonuses to see the total using this tool’s formula.
study.resultHint: Results update as you enter values.
study.stepMode: Choose grade conversion or admission scoring.
study.stepInput: Enter scores and applicable bonuses; enter 0 for no bonus.
study.stepRead: Read the result and check the grading rules where it will be used.
study.tip: Schools and admission years may use different scales or rules. Treat the result as a reference and check the applicable requirements.

pomodoro.inputHint: Choose suitable focus and break times. The defaults are 25 minutes of work and a 5-minute break.
pomodoro.stepSet: Set your focus and break durations.
pomodoro.stepFocus: Choose one task and press Start.
pomodoro.stepRest: Rest when time is up; press Start to run the next session.
pomodoro.tip: Have one specific task ready before each session. Keep the page open so the timer can work.

split.summaryHint: Choose page ranges or split the document into regular groups.
split.stepRange: Enter page ranges or choose the number of pages per part.
split.stepSave: Check the part count, split and download the PDF or ZIP.
split.tip: Commas start a new part; a hyphen selects a range. For example, 1-3, 5 creates one part with pages 1–3 and another with page 5.

gif.resultHint: Preview the animation and download the GIF after processing.
gif.rangeHint: Choose a clip up to 20 seconds, then set its width and frames per second.
gif.stepChoose: Choose a video and find the section to animate.
gif.stepSet: Enter the time range, width and frames per second.
gif.stepSave: Create the GIF, review it and download the animation.
gif.tip: GIFs have no sound. Shorter clips, smaller widths and fewer frames help reduce file size.

vietqr.inputHint: Enter the bank’s 6-digit BIN and receiving account. Optionally add an amount and transfer note.
vietqr.previewHint: Review the details before downloading or sharing.
vietqr.stepInput: Enter the BIN, account number and optional details.
vietqr.stepCheck: Test the code in a banking app and verify the recipient details.
vietqr.stepSave: Download PNG to share or SVG to print.
vietqr.tip: Get the BIN from the bank or a trusted source. This tool generates QR content and does not verify bank accounts.

ideas.formHint: Start with something you want to make easier in daily life.
ideas.stepDescribe: Describe the problem and give a concrete example of the tool you need.
ideas.stepSend: Review your content, give consent and submit the idea.
ideas.stepTrack: Keep the receipt code to check its status after submitting.
ideas.tip: A specific situation makes your needs clearer: what you are doing, where the difficulty is and what result you want.

payroll.inputHint: Choose a calculation direction and enter salary details. Add parameters in the card below to get a result.
payroll.resultHint: Based on the income details and parameters currently in use.
payroll.stepInput: Choose Gross → Net or Net → Gross and enter the salary.
payroll.stepRules: Apply a signed parameter package if available, or enter parameters from a suitable source.
payroll.stepRead: Review take-home pay, insurance, deductions and tax in the breakdown.
payroll.tip: Parameters may vary by date and circumstances. Check the source and ask your accounting team to review before using the result.

unitPrice.inputHint: Choose one common unit and enter each product’s price and quantity.
unitPrice.resultHint: Compare the price per unit to help make a choice.
unitPrice.stepUnit: Choose a shared unit: kilograms, liters or pieces.
unitPrice.stepInput: Enter each product’s price and quantity in the selected unit.
unitPrice.stepCompare: Review unit prices and the difference between products.
unitPrice.tip: Convert both quantities to the same unit before entering them. The unit selector changes labels; it does not convert entered values.

numberWords.inputHint: Enter an integer to write it in Vietnamese. Dots can separate groups of thousands.
numberWords.resultHint: The wording updates as you enter numbers or change reading preferences.
numberWords.stepInput: Enter the integer to convert to words.
numberWords.stepStyle: Choose the preferred linh / lẻ and bốn / tư wording.
numberWords.stepCopy: Review the text and press Copy result to use it.
numberWords.tip: The tool reads numbers without adding a currency unit. Check the number and wording conventions before using it in documents.

organize.summaryHint: Move, rotate or remove pages before creating a new PDF.
organize.controlsHint: Use the buttons below each page to reorder and rotate it.
organize.stepChoose: Choose one or more PDFs to display their pages in the grid.
organize.stepArrange: Move pages back or forward, rotate them or remove unneeded pages.
organize.stepSave: Check the order and retained page count, then create and download the new PDF.
organize.tip: Add files to append pages to the grid. Use {{reset}} to discard grid edits if needed.

wheel.inputHint: Add your choices, adjust the wheel and let a little surprise help you decide.
wheel.step1: Enter one choice per line in the list.
wheel.step2: Adjust sound and what happens to winning choices.
wheel.step3: Spin the wheel and read the result in the center.
wheel.tip: Save frequently used lists so you can load them for another spin.

barcode.inputHint: Enter content and choose the right barcode type. The preview updates when the content is valid.
barcode.resultHint: Check the barcode and its content before downloading.
barcode.step1: Choose a single barcode or a batch from a list.
barcode.step2: Enter data, select the barcode type and adjust dimensions.
barcode.step3: Preview and download in a suitable format.
barcode.tip: For product labels, check code allocation requirements and test a printed barcode at its actual size.

electricity.inputHint: Choose electricity or water, then enter usage and prices to estimate the cost.
electricity.resultHint: Based on your chosen usage, prices and tax.
electricity.step1: Choose electricity or water and enter usage.
electricity.step2: Check tiers, households and tax; for water, enter unit price and fees.
electricity.step3: Read the total and breakdown to compare with your bill.
electricity.tip: Check prices and tax against sources applicable to your billing period. Only the entered parameters are used.

imageText.inputHint: Choose the output format and document profile before recognizing text.
imageText.step1: Choose clear images containing the text you need.
imageText.step2: Choose a profile and output format, then start recognition.
imageText.step3: Review the recognized content and download the result.
imageText.tip: Good lighting, a straight camera angle and sharp text improve recognition. Check numbers, names and Vietnamese accents.

messageRisk.inputHint: Paste a message or link to inspect suspicious signs in its content.
messageRisk.resultHint: Content signals and explanations for your own review.
messageRisk.step1: Choose to inspect a message or a link.
messageRisk.step2: Paste the content and press Check to reach the results.
messageRisk.step3: Read each signal and verify through an official contact channel.
messageRisk.tip: Few signals do not mean safe. This tool analyzes pasted content without opening links or verifying sender identity.

formTemplates.inputHint: Choose a template and fill in your details; the preview follows your content.
formTemplates.resultHint: Review the document before downloading or printing.
formTemplates.step1: Choose the form or template you need.
formTemplates.step2: Fill in the details and check dates or amounts where applicable.
formTemplates.step3: Review the document, then download or print it.
formTemplates.tip: Each template keeps its own draft during the session. Check the recipient’s requirements before using it.

pageNumbers.inputHint: Choose the position, numbering style and pages to number.
pageNumbers.step2: Set the position, format, starting number and page range.
pageNumbers.step3: Preview, create and download the numbered PDF.
pageNumbers.tip: Leave enough room in the header or footer so numbers do not overlap content. Check both the first and last pages in the created file.

color.inputHint: Pick a color or enter a HEX, RGB or HSL code to convert between formats.
color.resultHint: Preview the color and its contrast with white and black text.
color.step1: Use the color picker or enter a valid color code.
color.step2: Read the HEX, RGB and HSL values and copy the code you need.
color.step3: Compare contrast ratios to choose a suitable text color.
color.tip: When using a background color, check contrast with the actual text color and font size in your design.

extractAudio.resultHint: Extracted audio appears here to preview and download.
extractAudio.stepChoose: Choose a video containing the audio you want.
extractAudio.stepSet: Select MP3, M4A or WAV and start extraction.
extractAudio.stepSave: Listen to the result and download the audio file.
extractAudio.tip: MP3 is useful for sharing, M4A uses AAC, and WAV files are usually larger. The video needs an audio stream to extract.

flashcard.inputHint: Write a question on the front and an answer on the back to create your own study cards.
flashcard.step1: Fill in both sides and add the card to your deck.
flashcard.step2: Try to answer before flipping the card.
flashcard.step3: Choose how well you remembered to schedule the next review.
flashcard.tip: Cards are saved in this browser. Clearing browser data may remove them. Keep each card focused on one short idea.

quickCalc.inputHint: Choose a category, shape or material, then enter dimensions using the units beside each field.
quickCalc.resultHint: Includes the calculation so you can check the entered values.
quickCalc.step1: Choose area, volume or mass and the formula you need.
quickCalc.step2: Enter dimensions and quantity, checking each field’s unit.
quickCalc.step3: Review the result and calculation, then copy the value.
quickCalc.tip: Convert values to the displayed units before entering them. Material mass is an estimate based on the chosen dimensions and parameters.

moneyCalc.inputHint: Choose a category and operation, then enter values to see the result.
moneyCalc.resultHint: See the calculation and related amounts for comparison.
moneyCalc.step1: Choose percentages, tax, profit or splitting costs.
moneyCalc.step2: Select an operation and enter the labeled values.
moneyCalc.step3: Review the calculation and breakdown, then copy the result.
moneyCalc.tip: For tax and discounts, establish whether the amount already includes them. Tax rates are entered by you and should be checked before use.

charCount.inputHint: Paste or type text here. Character, word, line and paragraph counts update automatically.
charCount.resultHint: Statistics for the text currently entered.
charCount.step1: Paste or enter the text to check.
charCount.step2: Read counts for characters, non-space characters, words, lines and paragraphs.
charCount.step3: Edit the content or clear the input to count another text.
charCount.tip: Word-counting methods can differ between platforms. Read each metric’s explanation when comparing content limits.

legacyFont.inputHint: Choose the conversion, then paste the text whose encoding or letter case you want to change.
legacyFont.resultHint: Updates with the source text and selected conversion.
legacyFont.step1: Choose the source encoding or an action such as removing accents or changing case.
legacyFont.step2: Paste the original text and compare the converted version.
legacyFont.step3: Check names and Vietnamese accents before copying.
legacyFont.tip: TCVN3 and VNI are character encodings. If your text is already Unicode, choose the appropriate action to avoid an incorrect conversion.

metadata.inputHint: Decode and re-export an image to create a new copy without the original metadata.
metadata.pickerHint: JPG, PNG, WebP · processed on your device
metadata.resultHint: A new image downloads after processing.
metadata.step1: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
metadata.step2: Check the filename and press Remove metadata.
metadata.step3: Open the downloaded image to check dimensions and quality.
metadata.tip: Re-exporting can change file size or quality. Text, license plates and information visible in the image must be covered or cropped separately.

invoiceXml.inputHint: Choose an XML file to read invoice details, item rows and totals.
invoiceXml.pickerHint: XML · up to 5 MB · read on your device
invoiceXml.resultHint: Details read from the selected XML file.
invoiceXml.step1: Choose an invoice XML file from your device.
invoiceXml.step2: Check the invoice number, seller, buyer and item list.
invoiceXml.step3: Review amounts and download an Excel or CSV item list.
invoiceXml.tip: An XML signature element does not establish a valid digital signature. This tool reads data without checking invoice status.

magnifier.inputHint: Use the camera to read small text, adjust magnification and pause the image when needed.
magnifier.resultHint: Monitor camera status and the current view.
magnifier.step1: Press Open camera and allow access when the browser asks.
magnifier.step2: Point at the detail, then adjust zoom and contrast.
magnifier.step3: Pause to read or close the camera when finished.
magnifier.tip: Keep the device steady and use good lighting for a clearer image. Pausing helps you read without holding the camera continuously.

documentOcr.inputHint: Choose an output format and document profile to extract text from PDFs or images.
documentOcr.step1: Choose PDFs or images containing the text you need.
documentOcr.step2: Choose the document profile and output, then start recognition.
documentOcr.step3: Review the recognized content before downloading.
documentOcr.tip: Clear scans and straight camera angles help recognition. Check numbers, names and words with low confidence carefully.

convertImage.inputHint: Choose JPG, PNG or WebP and a suitable quality level.
convertImage.step1: Choose one or more images to convert.
convertImage.step2: Select the target format and quality where available.
convertImage.step3: Convert and download the images or result package.
convertImage.tip: PNG is useful for keeping transparency. JPG does not preserve transparency; check the converted image.

batchImage.inputHint: Adjust dimensions, format and filenames in one processing step.
batchImage.step1: Choose the images you want to process together.
batchImage.step2: Set dimensions, format and filename pattern, then check the sample names.
batchImage.step3: Process and download the batch results.
batchImage.tip: Use {n} in the filename pattern to number images. Check dimensions and sample names before processing many files.

Ready for every day!
textStudio.textNote:
Enter your content
See the result!
textStudio.check: Check names, content and figures before copying, downloading or printing.
textStudio.privacy: Your content is processed in your browser.
textStudio.accountA: No. Enter your content and start using the tool straight away.
textStudio.privacyA: Content stays in the current session. Copy or download the result before leaving.
textStudio.cvPrivacyA: Your CV is remembered on this device only if you enable draft storage. Select your photo again in a new session.
textStudio.cvTemplateStep: Choose a CV template at the top of the workspace.

calculationStudio.heroNote:
Calculate faster
Make every number clear!
calculationStudio.calendarNote:
Find your dates
Plan every day!
calculationStudio.check: Check units, decimal separators and input values before using the result.
calculationStudio.networkQ: Do I need an internet connection?
calculationStudio.networkA: Calculations run on your device after the page loads. Copy or download your result before leaving.
calculationStudio.calendarPrivacy: Lunar/solar conversion runs on your device. Cross-checking sends the selected date to the server and needs a connection.
calculationStudio.calendarRange: Supports dates from 1800 to 2199. Holidays and cultural information are labeled separately for comparison.
calculationStudio.live: Results update as you change your inputs.
calculationStudio.loanBreakdown: Principal and interest in total repayment

units.step2: Enter a value and select the source and destination units.
units.step3: Read the result, swap units or copy a converted value.
units.tip: The entered value is converted into units in the selected group. Check the source and destination units after swapping.

loan.step1: Choose installment loan or renewing savings.
loan.step2: Enter the principal, annual interest rate and term, then select the calculation method.
loan.step3: Review the total and interest; download the loan schedule as CSV if needed.
loan.tip: The interest rate is a percentage per year. Check the term and repayment method against your actual contract.

dates.step1: Choose a date interval or add/subtract days.
dates.step2: Enter dates and day counts, checking whether to include the start date.
dates.step3: Read the result, review working days and copy the value you need.
dates.tip: Working days exclude Saturdays and Sundays, but do not subtract public holidays. Holidays are listed separately.

funStudio.heroNote:
Take a little break
Discover something new!
funStudio.reference: Interpretations are for entertainment and reflection. Read them alongside the calculation steps or card positions.
funStudio.numberPrivacy: Your birth date, optional name and selected year are sent for calculation after your consent. Results and interpretations are shown in the current session.
funStudio.cardPrivacy: Shuffling and drawing requires the server. Once you receive the cards, revealing them and reading interpretations happens on your device.
funStudio.wheelPrivacy: The wheel runs on your device. Saved lists stay in this browser and are not sent to the server.
funStudio.wheelTip: Enter at least two different options. Enable elimination to pick an order without repeating a winner.
funStudio.drawNote: Each draw keeps the same selected cards. Start a new session to change the card count or draw settings.

dailyStudio.flashcardNote:
Learn a little each day
Remember for longer!
dailyStudio.compassNote:
Find your direction
Plan your space!
dailyStudio.electricityPrivacy: Calculations run on your device. A connection is needed to load verified tariffs; you can also enter your own rates and tax.
dailyStudio.compassPrivacy: Images, drawings and measurements stay in this tab. Sensors require a supported device and permission; manual degree entry is always available.
dailyStudio.flashcardPrivacy: Cards are stored in this browser and can be reviewed offline after the page loads. Clearing browser data deletes saved cards.

officeStudio.heroNote:
Create with ease
Save on your device!
officeStudio.saveQ: Are documents automatically saved on the server?

slides.heading: Create a presentation or open a PowerPoint file
slides.stepOpen: Open the editor to create a presentation or open a PPTX file.
slides.stepEdit: Edit content, layout and formatting on your slides.
slides.stepSave: Save the PPTX file to your device before closing the editor.
slides.tip: Expand the workspace for more room to arrange slides. The editor interface is in English.
slides.note: Slides are edited on your device. Save the updated file before leaving this page.
